lakeSecondLeg.limitation: The cat did not continuously walk from the middle dock around the north and east shore to the recipient in this run. After the genuine carrier arrival, an intentional final-build reload tests recovery at the confirmed mail dock.

inputRegression.observation: An Escape/Return sequence during the intermediate lake play returned to the map. The observed sequence alone cannot disambiguate prior blur-pause from queued event replay.
inputRegression.diagnosis: Installed Phaser KeyboardManager -> KeyboardPlugin -> Key regression tests reproduce identical DOM keydown replay after resetKeys in both forest and lake controls. A per-binding WeakSet and closed-scene guard prevent duplicate handling.
inputRegression.finalBrowserCheck: Final CK6S0itx: Enter resumes the visible pause panel; sequential Escape/Return in one CUA call stays in the lake; one Escape opens pause, a later second Escape returns to the journey map. This UI smoke complements the 14 actual Phaser queue regression tests; it is not a frame-timing measurement.

Read both Puffer reply pages using Right; R returns to page 1; Escape closes the story.
Reload the completed final build. Menu keeps the prior practice 2 stars / 3 warm crystals / 1-2 resume entry. Journey map retains Puffer received status, new reply and lake shortcut.
Read-only DOM confirms data-game-ready=true and ./assets/index-CK6S0itx.js; captured warn/error logs are empty.
